mathematical_contract.authority: BezierParallel2::intersection_candidate_system remains the sole equation constructor and BezierParallel2::replay_degenerate_component remains the sole degenerate-component replay authority
mathematical_contract.independence_detection: after constructing the exact orthogonality and selected signed-distance equations, coefficient classification detects when both equations are independent of one authored parameter instead of accepting a false zero resultant as proof of disjointness
mathematical_contract.geometric_replay: under those two certified finite equations, an arbitrary operand is confined first to one source-normal line and then to one selected signed-distance point; exact point incidence therefore proves which geometric operand is constant
mathematical_contract.parameter_topology: a point-image component records fixed-t/full-u, full-t/fixed-u, or full-t/full-u without fabricating an isolated contact or discarding infinitely many parameter pairs
mathematical_contract.image_topology: zero-dimensional point images are represented separately from RationalBezierIntersectionOverlap2, whose contract remains a positive-length shared image
mathematical_contract.point_evidence: every published component retains RationalBezierIntersectionPointEvidence2::Exact and exact BezierParameter2 evidence for every fixed coordinate
mathematical_contract.closed_domains: a missing component coordinate denotes the complete authored closed unit interval, including both endpoints
mathematical_contract.fallback_semantics: constant detection is a speculative fast path until constancy is proved; uncertainty during the probe falls through to existing exact-rational or implicit replay, while uncertainty in incidence after constancy is proved remains authoritative
mathematical_contract.representation: BezierParallelIntersectionSet2 retains its two fat Arc slice pointers plus one optional thin Arc; the rare parameter-component payload reuses the former incomplete-evidence pointer and the common result remains 40 bytes on the benchmark target
mathematical_contract.strict: STRICT uses exact coefficient zero classification and exact point-incidence/root replay without a fixed refinement cap
mathematical_contract.approximate_512: APPROXIMATE_512 follows the identical equation, constancy, incidence, and result-construction path; only inherited Hyperreal equality terminals may stop at 512 bits, and no approximate parameter or point is synthesized
mathematical_contract.failure_semantics: non-axis repeated or non-square-free positive-dimensional derivative sharing and unsupported coefficient towers remain explicit rather than guessed
